environments.name: 春泽桥前竹木密林道空景
environments.body_en: An extraordinarily broad single official road through dense bamboo and tall woodland trees, wide enough for at least eight complete horse-drawn carriage travel envelopes side by side. Compacted-earth roadbed, drainage edges and wheel ruts, no modern lane markings. A right-side passing bay close to the forest edge has a continuous clear passenger-exit and ground-action area, plus a separate verge for four unmounted riding horses; no horses in the empty plate. The road leads to a forest opening; the bridge is screened by the bend and trees, no visible bridge deck. Rainy winter night, cool diffuse sky fill, shallow puddles and layered trunks. No people, vehicles or horses, no lanterns. Canopies border the road without closing its full width.
environments.checks: 至少八辆P01完整四驾行车包络并行，不按裸车厢或缩马计；唯一官道无支路，近林右侧会车区下车合阵，刺客不横越整幅路、C60局部树位；桥隐藏、车灯另合成。先过POST-PLAN-FOREST。

environments.name: 南街汤摊与街口
environments.body_en: A broad capital street with layered handsome timber shopfronts, deep tiled eaves and refined carved facade details, a small covered everyday soup stall beside an unobstructed continuous walkway. Ordinary pot and bowls, practical stall lanterns, damp stone paving and cool rainy night beyond the awning. Rich urban architectural depth, maintained surfaces and natural working life, no palace gate, no royal procession, no identifiable people.
environments.checks: 城景开阔精整，汤摊仍实用；不增加人物或改变顾府与同街西巷关系。

environments.name: 顾府外院
environments.body_en: The spacious ceremonial courtyard of an ancestral Chinese mansion, seen beneath its south veranda toward the lofty north reception hall. Tall solid timber gates, broad carved stone plinths and layered column bays establish formal depth; white plaster, blue-gray paving and selective white-marble accents. Winter plum, evergreen shrubs, sculptural rocks and large celadon vessels occupy garden margins. The east study and west guest-room passages keep their existing connections. No central pool or additional gateway across the clear route. A separate empty holding area for four riding horses remains outside the west wing along the wall, clear of doors. Empty environment, no people or animals. Bright natural neutral-white daylight from the courtyard and existing lattice openings, with skylight and reflected light from pale plaster and stone; white walls stay white, blue-gray stone stays gray, dark wood grain remains readable in shade, no amber or yellow cast, lamps unlit.
environments.checks: 南门北厅、东书房西卧房、西厢临院；冬梅侧缘成丛，主道无池、门道不堵；四马只在西厢外，精养华贵不作破宅。 高门世家古宅，厚梁深檐与大体量重工陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；固定动线与家具用途不变。

environments.name: 前厅固定大案
environments.body_en: A lofty south-facing reception hall in an ancestral Chinese mansion. A fixed heavy dark-hardwood table stands deep inside: exceptionally thick broad top, deep cloud-scroll carved apron, stout structural legs, fine joinery and selective gilding. Substantial high-backed chairs, freestanding tall cabinets, long display tables and thick-framed carved screens furnish distinct side bays; large porcelain, bronze vessels and scholar rocks arranged in measured groups. A separate smaller portable side table stands by the doorway. East passage to the study, west to the bedroom, central aisle clear. Hand-worked white plaster and dressed pale stone, empty hall. Bright natural neutral-white daylight from the courtyard and existing lattice openings, with skylight and reflected light from pale plaster and stone; white walls stay white, blue-gray stone stays gray, dark wood grain remains readable in shade, no amber or yellow cast, lamps unlit.
environments.checks: 固定大案深处，门边小案可搬且不能互换；重工鎏金暗纹、陈设丰富、通道完整；真票始终在内。 高门世家古宅，厚梁深檐与大体量重工陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；固定动线与家具用途不变。

environments.name: 外院西厢
environments.body_en: A richly furnished west guest-room suite opening east onto the ancestral mansion courtyard. Individual carved hardwood canopy beds with stout posts and layered carved cornices, ivory brocade bedding, pale-jade curtains, substantial freestanding cabinets and framed screens. Local gilding and fine inlay follow the carving. Show one coherent room view; other beds remain in adjoining rooms of the existing five-bed plan. Separate personal-luggage, dry-equipment and meal-preparation zones; an ordinary travel cooking pot is kept off the beds. Clear exit, empty room, no floor pallets or horses. Bright clear winter morning after rain, damp stone retained, natural neutral-white daylight and skylight, no amber or yellow cast, lamps unlit.
environments.checks: 正式独立架子床，总计五床由平面逐间核数，不强求单图五床；行囊、器物、饭食与床具分区；马只在室外。 高门世家古宅，厚梁深檐与大体量重工陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；固定动线与家具用途不变。

environments.name: 书房
environments.body_en: A lofty expansive ancestral Chinese study with writing, reading, reception and resting zones separated by heavy carved beams and thick-framed screens. A monumental but usable dark-hardwood writing desk: thick broad top, deeply carved cloud-scroll apron, stout legs, selective gilding and small mother-of-pearl inlay. Freestanding book cabinets, substantial display shelves, long tables, large porcelain and bronze vessels, scholar rocks and a carved daybed occupy the perimeter. A plain bronze mirror, shaded oil lamp and cup retain their fixed usable desk positions. The ordinary inward door bolt, courtyard lattice window and low cabinet directly beneath it remain in a compact clear action area. Bare stone at the cup-fall position; rugs only in the distant sitting zone. Cool night window light and localized warm desk lamp, no glowing mechanism, empty room.
environments.checks: 大书房四功能区，家具深木重雕鎏金暗纹；案窗门动作邻接不放大；普通铜镜、杯落裸石、柜在窗下、内闩可见；无密室线索。 高门世家古宅，厚梁深檐与大体量重工陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；固定动线与家具用途不变。

environments.name: 卧房
environments.body_en: The private bedchamber of an ancestral Chinese mansion, separate from the study. A substantial carved dark-hardwood canopy bed against the inner wall, stout posts, layered deeply carved cornice, selective gilding and dark tonal ornament. Ivory brocade bedding and pale-jade silk curtains tied aside, a thick-topped bedside table, large freestanding wardrobe and heavy carved screen. The familiar bed height and clear bedside care space remain connected directly to the corridor door. Cool night ambience and one sheltered local warm bedside lamp, no mirror or broken cup, empty room.
environments.checks: 正式豪华床具，床边容照料者、帘侧收不遮伤者；与书房分室，不复制铜镜碎杯窗闩。 高门世家古宅，厚梁深檐与大体量重工陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；固定动线与家具用途不变。

environments.name: 后院井边
environments.body_en: The spacious working rear courtyard of the same ancestral Chinese mansion, substantial carved timber framing and carefully dressed blue-gray paving. A practical stone well, ordinary washing basin, wooden bucket and laundry rack occupy the side beside winter evergreen planting. The existing short covered passage back to the hall remains clear. Craftsmanship is coherent with the mansion but utility objects remain practical, no people. Bright clear winter morning after rain, damp stone retained, natural neutral-white daylight and skylight, no amber or yellow cast, lamps unlit.
environments.checks: 后院华贵木作与实用井桶并存；韩府内洗手、杜廊口交接，井与外库不混点。 高门世家古宅，厚梁深檐与大体量重工陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；固定动线与家具用途不变。

environments.name: 外库门前
environments.body_en: The exterior storage-room doorway on the east rear passage of an ancestral Chinese mansion. Thick dark timber door leaves, deeply framed carved borders and carefully worked bronze fittings, solid threshold and textured pale plaster. Lower ceremonial rank than the main hall, no treasury display. Door slightly ajar but storage interior not displayed. Cool rainy-night ambience and local warm spill from the existing corridor lamp. No seal, guards or glowing mechanism.
environments.checks: 外库外观精整，等级低于正厅；首夜无封、不展示内部，不以奢华暴露隐室或遗信。 高门世家古宅，厚梁深檐与大体量重工陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；固定动线与家具用途不变。

environments.name: 现代岩壁局部
environments.body_en: A close view of an outdoor climbing rock face meeting firm flat ground, a small section of a slack climbing rope, cool diffuse daylight, realistic rough stone and ordinary vegetation at the edge, no people or cliff fall, contemporary outdoor photographic finish.
environments.checks: 只有主动收工局部；不画坠崖、尸体、现代正脸

environments.name: 顾府连廊与书房门口夜景
environments.body_en: A deep covered veranda of the ancestral Chinese mansion, massive carved timber columns and layered beam brackets, thick-framed lattice transoms, fine gilded relief and dressed blue-gray stone. Winter plum at the courtyard edge. Study door and adjacent seated waiting area remain close together; ordinary laundry rack stays clear of the walking line. North hall and courtyard gateway appear through successive column frames without compressing distance. Cool clear night ambience and small sheltered practical lamps illuminating only nearby wood, no global yellow or blue tint, empty set.
environments.checks: 同一POST-PLAN-COURT平面；韩与顾伯在书房紧邻廊下，外院杜另有距离，不能隔院瞬移；衣架不挡门。 高门世家古宅，厚梁深檐与大体量重工陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；固定动线与家具用途不变。

props.name: 四驾封闭精致豪华马车｜空车母版
props.body_en: One stately luxurious enclosed Chinese period carriage, four-wheel wooden body with an elegant solid curved roof, deep ebony-brown lacquer, restrained dark vermilion trim, finely carved geometric window frames, opaque silk-lined privacy curtains behind small shuttered windows, discreet aged gilt-bronze fittings, refined joinery and subtle maintained wear. A closed hinged right-side passenger door with a low boarding step, an external front driver bench clearly separated from the enclosed passenger cabin. A visible central draw pole and balanced harness attachment appearance designed for a four-horse team abreast. One small enclosed travel lantern fixed at the front. Full unobstructed three-quarter right-side object view, neutral ground and soft studio light, no horses, no people, no royal dragons, no magical glow, no open canopy.
props.checks: 四马并列牵引的封闭豪华车，固定四轮、实体顶、右侧铰接门及踏阶、独立外驾座；精雕深漆与克制鎏铜，不改成露天敞棚或帝王龙辇。车厢不透明，车灯不自动照穿侧壁；与已选四匹牵引马合成时核验数量及比例。空车探索尚未生成；结构、驾乘与动物安全须专业审阅。

props.body_en: One small soft-mouthed dark cloth travel bag, tied opening, worn dense cotton, modest bulge from folded papers and personal belongings, three-quarter object view on warm-gray ground, soft side light revealing seams.
props.checks: 软口和小体量，不用许照邻方口包；军引、布套、零钱可容纳

props.name: 东巡所收件纸空底
props.body_en: One fresh small pale paper receipt, a clear ruled layout with separate blank item lines and a lower signing area, top-down flat view, soft even light, no lettering.

props.name: 完整杯母形
props.body_en: One small plain pale ceramic drinking cup with a modest rounded lip and subtle glaze variation, isolated three-quarter view, soft side light, neutral background.
props.checks: 完整/碎裂必须同杯，碎片单独延展；不是毒杯

props.name: 布药箱
props.body_en: One modest cloth-wrapped wooden medicine box with plain compartments closed, warm-gray cotton wrap, careful old stitching, neutral tabletop object view, soft side lighting.
props.checks: 顾伯照护物，普通无神医符纹；张济诊具另在摆设项

props.name: 王寿短刃外观
props.body_en: One plain compact theatrical short blade with a simple dark handle and a matching closed scabbard beside it, dull low-gloss metal, neutral horizontal product view, diffuse light. Restrained xianxia fantasy drama craftsmanship: elegant designed contours, refined silver-gray and smoky-blue metal planes, subtle sculpted cloud-line fittings and maintained lacquered wood where applicable. Avoid archaeological realism, heavy corrosion and crude surface damage. Preserve the assigned weapon type and role; no added magical power or self-emission.
props.checks: 仅外观道具概念，不给尺寸磨刃或操作方法；不加上游徽记

props.name: 现代袖与绳局部
props.body_en: A cropped chalk-dusted adult Chinese man's hand withdrawing from rock after a climb, ordinary gray-blue modern outdoor sleeve, slack rope at the side and stable ground below, diffuse daylight, no face in frame.
props.checks: 现代29岁陈渡局部，不是杨舟，不是坠落，不作绳具操作教程

props.name: 浅灰干衣版型
props.body_en: One folded pale-gray cross-collar inner robe made of dense soft cotton, smoky-gray edging, precise plain seams, neutral tabletop view under diffuse light, no embroidery or jewellery. Opaque fine cotton cloth with smoky-gray silk-twill bound collar edging, soft matte folds; no travel outer robe.

props.name: 糖罐与勺

props.name: 共同饭钱账

props.name: 普通骑乘马与旅鞍母形

props.name: 五卒轻皮内甲独立母形
props.body_en: One removed fictional period light leather under-armor on a faceless neutral torso stand, thin close-fitting dark-brown leather panels, soft shoulder edges, compact short lower panels, discreet cloth-bound seams and concealed fastenings, subtle maintained wear, isolated three-quarter costume study in diffuse light, no outer jacket, no long armored skirt, no glowing marks, no weapons.
props.checks: 只做单独取下的P20内甲母形；正式出场穿在高级劲装里面，只露局部暗皮边与受力轮廓。五人各自体量适配，非外披胸甲；P16另计，外衣不透明，暗纹非导息电路；无实物防护验证。

architecture_direction.family_en: An ancestral compound of a prestigious old Chinese lineage, strictly period architecture: massive timber columns, deep tiled eaves, layered carved beam brackets with localized gilding and substantial door frames. Rich craftsmanship within a solemn axial hierarchy, not an imperial palace. No modern New Chinese villa, panoramic glass walls, LED strips, modern sofa grouping or glossy marble tiles.
architecture_direction.daylight_en: Bright natural neutral-white daylight from the courtyard and existing lattice openings, with skylight and reflected light from pale plaster and stone; white walls stay white, blue-gray stone stays gray, dark wood grain remains readable in shade, no amber or yellow cast, lamps unlit.
architecture_direction.morning_en: Bright clear winter morning after rain, damp stone retained, natural neutral-white daylight and skylight, no amber or yellow cast, lamps unlit.
architecture_direction.checks: 高门世家大宅、华丽奢华庄重宏大雅致；厚梁深檐、重工大体量陈设，非现代新中式豪宅；日光白不偏黄、夜灯仅局部。私宅非皇宫，不新增院落动线，不抬高窗柜或床面；门边小案可搬。

portrait_direction.background_policy: 按衣色与肤色选择低信息摄影棚背景，不固定单色；弱木格仅虚化局部，不成为剧情场景。
portrait_direction.light_policy: 中性白平衡、有方向的大面积柔光；脸和织物保留细节，不加暖金逆光或梦幻泛光。
portrait_direction.checks: 按裁幅验收：身份脸与发髻完整；全身衣装含手脚；背面核发结与背缝；细节核领襟腰封。背景服务人物，真实肌理与年龄不磨掉。
